"""Bind actual reviewed conclusions,tables and native galleries into the report."""
import html
import re
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1'
notes=root/'human-quality-notes-v1.md';assert notes.is_file() and len(notes.read_text())>300
assert read(root/'native-viewing-v1.json')['primary_figures_covered']==72
assert read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')['status']=='pass'
tables=read(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json');figures=read(root/'figures-v1.json')
assert len(tables['cells'])==205 and figures['all_RGB_channels_checked']==50764800
review=read(root/'review-result-v1.json');execution=read(root/'execution-completion-v1.json')
assert execution['head_calls']==5364 and execution['recorded_owner_count']==15
text='# Paired response: V160 final quality\n\n'+notes.read_text().strip()+'\n\n'
text+='[Final evidence and immutable sources](results/v160-paired-response-final-v1.json) · '
text+='[Native pixels, source ROIs, conditioning, exposure and checkpoint hashes](images/v160-paired-response-v1/manifest-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Response and actual blank error\n\n'
text+='RMS values are camera-RGB DN16. Response1 means the exact constructed mesh amplitude. Blank error measures actual target error; added blank RMS measures displacement from V143.\n\n'+tables['sections']['mesh']+'\n'
text+='## Quiet neighbors and coarse fields\n\n'+tables['sections']['quiet']+'\n'
dc=read(root/'quiet-DC-audit-v1.json')
text+='Quiet bias is averaged per RGB channel before its Euclidean RMS. The independent pixel audit verifies total squared = spatial squared + DC squared per case; means of RMS values do not share that identity.\n\n'
text+='| Prior | Method | Quiet DC RMS DN16 |\n| --- | --- | ---: |\n'
for item in dc['groups']:
    text+=f"| {item['prior']} | {item['method']} | {item['mean_DC_RMS_DN16']:.6f} |\n"
text+='\n'+tables['sections']['flat']+'\n'
text+='## Natural detail and ADC controls\n\n'+tables['sections']['photo']+'\n'+tables['sections']['ADC']+'\n'
text+='## Fixed native comparisons\n\n'
text+='Every cell is native 160×160; crop pixels are never resized. All RAW methods within each board share source coordinates, camera display transform, exposure and contrast. JPEG cells retain native sRGB8 without exposure/contrast changes. Both final raw/EMA endpoints of both heads are shown, with five retained V156/V157/V158/V159 columns.\n\n'
text+='The main scene is DSCF3879 ISO6400 versus DSCF3880 ISO100 f/5.6. The fine cab mesh uses DSCF3842 versus DSCF3835 and both camera JPEGs. Aperture, shutter, moving subjects and processing differ: ISO100 views are qualitative references, not exact GT. All30 real score rows stay unscored.\n\n'
categories=[('mesh','Mesh and exact absence'),('mixed-quiet','Quiet neighbors beside edges'),
    ('flat','Standalone flats and slopes'),('photo','Natural photographic detail'),('real','Protected real GFX scenes')]
for kind,title in categories:
    text+=f'### {title}\n\n'
    for item in figures['images']:
        if 'triplet_source_board' in item or item['case']['kind']!=kind:continue
        name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
        text+=f"{item['case']['id']}; ROI `{item['ROI_xywh']}`, RAW exposure {item['exposure']:g}, contrast {item['contrast']:g}.\n\n"
        text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}, native comparison](images/v160-paired-response-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='### Noisy, restored, exact constructed GT triplets\n\n'
for item in figures['images']:
    if 'triplet_source_board' not in item:continue
    name=Path(item['image']['path']).name
    text+=f"![{item['case']['id']}; {item['panels'][1]['label']}; native triplet](images/v160-paired-response-v1/{name})\n\n"
text+='## Training, sources and validation\n\n'
text+='Two fresh identical 117,677-parameter / 45-tensor spatial-RGB heads share 1,000 fresh B4 batches. Only pair-loss weight 0 versus 1 changes between current arms. Both use V159 smooth regional-DC/local RGB regret, delivered spectral MSE .25, pixel/gradient/domain weights, AdamW, clipping and EMA. The new ordinary control differs from archived V159 in data and noise realization; retained comparisons include that change.\n\n'
mix=read(root/'training-data-mix-v1.json')
text+=f"The cache contains 4,000 frames: 1,382 present/background pairs and 1,236 ordinary frames, based on {mix['underlying_scene_or_patch_instances']:,} scene/patch instances. Its 486 photo pairs visit {mix['photo_source_ids']} distinct free-photo sources; {mix['photo_reduced_contrast_pairs']} use reduced contrast and {mix['photo_reviewed_ROI_pairs']} use reviewed ROIs. Data use bin4 caches, geometry before area2 and zero optical blur. All 18 held-out photo IDs and protected captures/JPEGs/siblings remain excluded.\n\n"
text+='Pair units are the pre-ADC shot-increment RMS, floored at 16 DN16; read draws are shared. They are training proxies for RGB differences. Photo backgrounds are constructed channel means. Pair loss cancels common RGB mistakes, so ordinary/local/DC supervision remains necessary. Targets/pair fields never enter the head.\n\n'
text+='123 CPU checks pass in three suites: 118 inherited/paired, 3 corrected counter regressions and 2 batch-isolation checks. Genuine 8+2 model/EMA/Adam/RNG restoration passes; 450 parameter gradients match extracted frozen V159 loss arithmetic on the fresh control data. The first 10 complete smoke/train rows match exactly. CUDA parity covers 28 contexts / 56 calls. Four strict final CPU loads and 90 finite Adam states at 1,000 pass.\n\n'
routing=read(root/'training-routing-summary-v1.json')
for item in routing['groups']:
    if item['ADC_only']:continue
    text+=f"`{item['arm']}`: {item['norms_over_one']}/{item['batches']} supervised batches clip; pre-clip norm median {item['norm_median']:.6f}, maximum {item['norm_maximum']:.6f}.\n\n"
text+='The 100 zero-gradient ADC batches advance Adam/EMA clocks. Gradient norms describe optimization pressure; they do not isolate the cause of a quality change.\n\n'
audit=read(root/'independent-metrics-audit-v1.json')
text+=f"The independent audit checks {audit['scalar_checks']:,} scalars across 4,686 rows and {audit['Decimal_reductions']} Decimal reductions; maximum scalar difference is{audit['maximum_scalar_difference']:.3g}. All 72 native images / 24 triplets were actually viewed in 18 original-detail sheets;50,764,800 RGB channels were independently checked.\n\n"
text+='Actual scientific work is 5,364 head calls (56 parity, 20 discarded smoke, 2,000 training, 3,288 review) plus 1,000 new parent and 1,000 nested DINO batch calls. Head calls evaluate 11,424 images; parent/DINO each evaluate 4,000. All 3,288 review arrays / 8.842 GiB are new and external. Original captures and `/mnt/dataz` are unused.\n\n'
text+='The first cache attempt stopped at source24 because a procedural Gaussian draw entered its sensor counter. Its original receipts/sources are preserved. Boundary counters pass bit-identical regression checks; the explicit continuation adopts all 23 completed parent batches and computes the remaining 977. The extra source24 construction remains counted: 4,004 actual source frames and 3,312 Poisson / 1,928 Gaussian sensor API calls. No successful parent forward or full training run was repeated. All 15 recorded owners are terminal.\n\n'
text+='The executed cache receipt retains a legacy 990/adopt10 prose line; its actual 977/adopt23 fields, adoption manifest and execution ledger provide the corrected scope. The study retains 60/156 GiB local/external reserves and 0.5 GiB projected margin. All 87 prior neural sources remain unchanged. Historical preparation and explicitly labeled UTC machine timestamps are preserved.\n\n'
text+='[Original preparation and input inspections](results/v160-paired-response-preparation-v1.json) · [batch isolation](results/v160-paired-batch-isolation-v1.json).\n\n'
text+='## Photographic credits\n\nDerived native targets/crops retain the respective source licenses; transformations include linearization, area binning and exposure/contrast changes. Source IDs and ROIs are in the manifest.\n\n| Source | Author | License |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n'
credits={}
for case in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']:
    if case['kind']=='photo':credits[case['source']['sha1']]=case['source']
assert len(credits)==18
for s in credits.values():
    author=html.unescape(re.sub('<[^>]*>','',s['author'])).replace('|','\\|').replace('\n',' ')
    text+=f"| [{s['title']}]({s['page_url']}) | {author} | [{s['license']}]({s['license_url']}) |\n"
text+='\n## Fixed component checkpoints\n\n'
for label,binding in review['collections'].items():
    text+=f"- `{label}`: `{read(binding['path'])['export']['sha256']}`.\n"
target=repo/'docs/paired-response.md';target.write_text(text)
receipt=root/'human-report-builder-v1.json';assert not receipt.exists()
save(receipt,{'status':'built-from-actually-reviewed-notes-and-audited-tables','report':ref(target),'notes':ref(notes),
    'table_bindings':ref(root/'report-table-bindings-v1.json'),'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
print('Built actual final quality report with205 score cells,10 quiet-DC cells and72 native images')
